metadata.description: Azure region for all resources. Must support Flex Consumption.
Log Analytics workspace name.
Workspace data retention (days). 30-730. Use 400 for 12+ month reports.
Globally unique storage account name (3-24 lowercase chars).
Function App name.
Flex Consumption plan name.
Private blob container that stores the HTML/CSV reports.
Private blob container that Flex Consumption uses for the deployed code package.

Create a NAT gateway for the Function subnet. The Function reads the resource inventory from Azure Resource Graph through management.azure.com, which has no private endpoint: this single flow leaves through the NAT gateway while the subnet NSG only allows the AzureResourceManager service tag. Set false only if you provide the same egress yourself (hub firewall/UDR to management.azure.com, or ARM Private Link). Ignored when an existing VNet is used.
Address space for the VNet hosting private endpoints + Function integration (ignored when an existing VNet is used).
Subnet for private endpoints (ignored when an existing VNet is used).
Delegated subnet for Function VNet integration (Flex Consumption: /27 minimum, /26 recommended; ignored when an existing VNet is used).

Existing subnet for the private endpoints (resource ID, any resource group or subscription). Set it together with existingFunctionSubnetId to use an existing VNet; leave both empty to create vnet-sla. The deployment identity needs Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/subnets/join/action on it.

Existing subnet for the Function VNet integration (resource ID). Must be in the Function region, delegated to Microsoft.App/environments, /27 or larger and not used by anything else. The template does not change it, so it must already allow outbound HTTPS to management.azure.com (NAT gateway, hub firewall/UDR or ARM Private Link).

Existing Azure Monitor Private Link Scope (resource ID, any resource group or subscription). When set, the workspace, Application Insights and the data collection endpoint are added to it and no scope or scope private endpoint is created; the scope, its private endpoint and its DNS must already serve the Function VNet. The deployment identity needs Contributor (or scopedResources/write plus deployments/write) on the scope resource group.
Create private DNS zone groups on the private endpoints. Set false when DNS records are created by policy or central DNS; no zones are created either.

Existing private DNS zones by key (blob, queue, table, sites, monitor, oms, ods, agentsvc), each a resource ID that can be in another subscription. A listed zone is used as is and must already be linked to (or resolvable from) the Function VNet; the deployment identity needs Private DNS Zone Contributor on it. Every key left out is created here and linked to the VNet.
Tag applied to all resources.
